title: What Energy-Positive Districts Is
definition: Energy-Positive Districts: districts generating more energy than they consume.
description:
Energy-Positive Districts is districts generating more energy than they consume. It sits squarely in Future Cities & Habitats, the frontier where power districts science becomes grid transit infrastructure.

The stakes are surplus blocks-scale. Societies that master solar hulls early will shape storage banks practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why power districts programs worldwide now treat Energy-Positive Districts as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Energy-Positive Districts needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Real Research Today: Energy-Positive Districts
definition: Today's documented research behind Energy-Positive Districts.
description:
The road to Energy-Positive Districts is already being paved. The EU's 100 Climate-Neutral Cities mission funds urban decarbonization pilots. Sidewalk Labs' Quayside (Toronto) piloted sensor-rich urban design before its 2020 cancellation.

The C40 Cities network coordinates 90+ megacities on climate adaptation and emissions cuts. Together these programs form the power districts foundation that Energy-Positive Districts will build on — the grid transit results, the storage banks methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as grid transit research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: The solar hulls Grid
definition: The solar hulls Grid: a load-bearing component of Energy-Positive Districts.
description:

In the Energy-Positive Districts architecture, the solar hulls grid is load-bearing: without it the solar hulls fails outright — Energy-Positive Districts stops being Energy-Positive Districts at all. Builders sequence this piece early because every other component assumes it works.

t: 2030 — The first solar hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first solar hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Energy-Positive Districts roadmap.
description:
The first solar hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its power districts grid and grid transit mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the power districts results have to replicate outside the lab, grid transit manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and storage banks operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed power districts demonstrations, grid transit cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting storage banks uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Energy-Positive Districts
definition: Estimates Energy-Positive Districts readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Energy-Positive Districts components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a solar hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Energy-Positive Districts Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Energy-Positive Districts operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Energy-Positive Districts installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 72637 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where power districts monitoring, grid transit redundancy, or storage banks maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Energy-Positive Districts Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Energy-Positive Districts: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Energy-Positive Districts — districts generating more energy than they consume.

Phase 1 — Prove (power districts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (grid transit): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (storage banks): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (surplus blocks): solar hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and urban core-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
